jobs.description: Do you want to build the financial foundation an entire business runs on? We are looking for a Finance leader to manage the infrastructure build out and standardization of the cost reporting, metrics, and definitions behind Amazon's $1.2B+ US Imports network. This is not a role that maintains someone else's reporting. You will decide how imports cost gets measured, build the pipeline that produces it, and own the network-level view leadership uses to understand why cost moved. If you are energized by ambiguity, by standardizing what has never been standardized, and by work that is foundational to the business, this is one of the highest-leverage seats in Inbound finance. Global Logistics supports Amazon-managed Inbound transportation service offerings across Domestic and Import vendors and sellers. This role sits at the intersection of our Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, FP&A, Operations, Product and Controllership partners — building out the imports cost reporting pipeline, standardizing the definitions, metrics and KPIs the imports team reports on, and partnering with central FP&A to embed those standards in weekly business reviews, month-end close, and the OP and quarterly guidance cycles. Key job responsibilities - Build and own the US Imports cost reporting pipeline in partnership with Business Intelligence and Data Engineering teams, acting as the finance product owner from requirements through acceptance and validation. - Establish and govern the metric and KPI standards for imports — cost per container, cost per unit, cost per FEU, dwell, utilization and mix ratios — defining the grain and scope boundary for each, and enforcing consistent use across Finance, Operations, and Forecasting teams. - Support building the network-level cost bridge, decomposing volume/mix/rate variances across all eight import cost legs and reconciling bottoms-up leg builds into one auditable view each reporting cycle. - Partner with central FP&A to standardize reporting mechanisms across weekly business reviews, month-end close and planning cycles, improving both cycle time and accuracy. - Proactively identify unowned and misallocated cost streams — new corridors, new program launches, cross-org entitlements — quantify the exposure, and drive each to a named owner. A day in the life You will start your day on the network bridge, tracing an unexpected transload adjustment back to a source data field before anyone builds commentary on a number that is incorrect. You might then spend an hour with Data Engineering mapping a new charge code that is currently landing in an unallocated bucket, then give Topology the leg-level cost build for a proposed new node — not a single blended number, but the underlying input assumptions that will actually drive the decision. In the afternoon you settle a definitional conflict with central FP&A where the same cost-per-container figure does not tie between the business review and the planning file because the denominators differ, and you update the template so the decision is enforced by the mechanism instead of by your memory. Throughout, you will balance the recurring weekly and monthly review cadences against the longer-horizon work to streamline and automate recurring issues.

DashMart is a local-fulfillment center owned and operated by DoorDash, offering customers household essentials and other items to their doorsteps with speed, reliability, and quality. DashMart is looking for a motivated and experienced individual that excels in fast-paced, physical environments and is excited to roll up their sleeves and actively engage in day-to-day operations. In this role, you will work within a local fulfillment center supporting Site Management running great shifts, and delegating tasks. As a Shift Lead, you will have shift responsibility for fulfilling orders in a warehouse environment and maintaining inventory, and in some locations, this involves preparing food in a light-prep kitchen.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Be an Owner: Take ownership of your assigned shifts, including warehouse and kitchen processes, safety/cleanliness, quality, and training. Maintain accountability for inventory, equipment, and other company assets to ensure they are properly handled, stored, and protected from loss or theft.
Delight Customers: Ensure customer orders are delivered with high quality by executing orders accurately, communicating with customers when issues arise, and making sure Dasher pickups go smoothly.
Lead: Guide Operations Associates through their shift by ensuring the team works safely and productively and serving as the point of escalation for daily operations.
One Team One Fight: Support operations in both the warehouse and kitchen, assist with day-to-day tasks, and lead by example. You will be expected to engage in professional and respectful interactions with team members and customers, ensuring a positive and safe atmosphere in the warehouse while providing a high-quality experience for our customers.

You’re self-motivated, positive, and a team player. You work well with others, and you bring a great attitude to your work each and every day. You have high integrity and are excited to delight customers.

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.
Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.
UNREAL ENGINE LEARNING RESOURCES
What We Do
Epic's Education & Learning team provides accessible ways for current and aspiring creators to learn the real-time 3D tools and skills they need to be successful.
What You'll Do
As Director of Education & Training you will lead a team that is passionate about learning and driven to engage with educators and students--whether in an academic setting or through professional growth. You will set the strategy for growing adoption of Epic tools in educational markets and providing learning content that meets the needs of an evolving market, showcasing Epic’s latest technical capabilities. You will also engage regularly with educators and users through events and programs that tap into high-growth opportunities.
In this role, you will
Accelerate adoption in target markets via institutional partnerships and curriculum support
Oversee tool-specific bootcamps focused on career tracks and industry showcases
Drive a Train-the-Trainer program to scale technical instruction globally through external partners
Oversee regional initiatives to boost local markets, grow adoption, and increase Epic's visibility through events and speaking engagements
Foster engagement by collaborating with the Community team to facilitate programs, deliver content, and encourage community-led learning
Set strategy and vision for enabling infrastructure including tooling (Interactive Partner Directory, LMS) and certification pathways that promote and reward learning
Establish and track metrics that gauge effectiveness of programs and content
What we're looking for
10+ years in Education, Training, or a related field, with an emphasis on technology and learning platforms
The ability to think critically and adapt in a fast-paced environment, leveraging the latest technologies and pedagogical approaches
A passion for game development and Epic’s primary industries
Experience leading high-performing cross-functional teams and collaborating with stakeholders in multiple business functions
A track record of setting effective strategy and leading successful programs that deliver measurable results
Experience managing a budget and building scalable services efficiently
EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE
Our intent is to cover all things that are medically necessary and improve the quality of life. We pay 100% of the premiums for both you and your dependents. Our coverage includes Medical, Dental, a Vision HRA, Long Term Disability, Life Insurance & a 401k with competitive match. We also offer a robust mental well-being program through Modern Health, which provides free therapy and coaching for employees & dependents. Throughout the year we celebrate our employees with events and company-wide paid breaks. We offer unlimited PTO and sick time and recognize individuals for 7 years of employment with a paid sabbatical.

Epic Games​ ​is a leading interactive entertainment company. For over 30 years we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design.
